# ShitUI

> Free & Open Source animated React UI component library built with Tailwind CSS, Next.js, and Motion. Beautiful by default, interactive by nature, and effortlessly customizable. Distributed via shadcn CLI.

- Website: https://shitui.in
- Documentation: https://shitui.in/docs
- Official Twitter / X: https://x.com/shituihq (@shituihq)
- Founder & Creator: Swapnil Kalambe (https://x.com/heyyswap - @heyyswap)
- Contact Email: useshit.ui@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Codewithswappy/ShitUI
- License: MIT License (100% free for personal and commercial use)
- Formerly: RareUI (rareui.in)

## Installation & Distribution

ShitUI is distributed as copy-and-own React code compatible with the shadcn CLI registry v4.

### 1. Install via shadcn CLI
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/<component-name>
```

Or install via direct registry JSON URL:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://shitui.in/r/<component-name>.json
```

### 2. Configure components.json (Optional)
To use the `@shitui` shorthand anywhere:
```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@shitui": "https://shitui.in/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

## Available Components & Documentation

- [Animated Tab](https://shitui.in/docs/components/animated-tab): Fluid navigation tabs with a sliding background highlight pill. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/animated-tab`
- [Book 3D](https://shitui.in/docs/components/book-3d): Interactive 3D book cover with realistic cursor-following tilt and shadow physics. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/book-3d`
- [Dynamic Island Navigation](https://shitui.in/docs/components/dynamic-island-nav): Adaptive iOS-inspired Dynamic Island navbar with fluid morphing and mobile drawer. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/dynamic-island-nav`
- [Floating Navigation](https://shitui.in/docs/components/floating-navigation): Floating pill navbar with glassmorphism and smooth active indicator. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/floating-navigation`
- [Liquid Button](https://shitui.in/docs/components/liquid-button): Organic gooey liquid dripping hover effect with SVG filter displacement. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/liquid-button`
- [Liquid Tooltip](https://shitui.in/docs/components/liquid-tooltip): Jelly morphing elastic tooltip that tracks cursor motion dynamically. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/liquid-tooltip`
- [Liquid Wave](https://shitui.in/docs/components/liquid-wave): Ambient fluid water ripple wave background effect. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/liquid-wave`
- [Loading Spinner](https://shitui.in/docs/components/loading-spinner): Minimalist, ultra-clean SVG loading animations. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/loading-spinner`
- [Magnetic Scatter Text](https://shitui.in/docs/components/magnetic-scatterText): Kinetic typography that organically scatters letters away from cursor proximity. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/magnetic-scatterText`
- [Premium Button](https://shitui.in/docs/components/premium-button): Polished CTA button with dynamic light sheen and micro-interaction states. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/premium-button`
- [Retro Pixel Button](https://shitui.in/docs/components/retro-pixel-button): 8-bit arcade aesthetic button with authentic stepped bevel shadows. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/retro-pixel-button`
- [Sound Text](https://shitui.in/docs/components/sound-text): Audio frequency visualizer wave typography animation. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/sound-text`
- [Split FAQ](https://shitui.in/docs/components/split-faq): Kinetic grouped accordion where open questions split into independent cards with spring physics. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/split-faq`
- [Toast Tabs](https://shitui.in/docs/components/toast-tabs): Stacked card notification tabs with spring physics and depth layering. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/toast-tabs`
- [Vapor Smoke Text](https://shitui.in/docs/components/vapor-smokeText): Ethereal vapor dispersion and dissipation text effect. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/vapor-smokeText`
- [Word Magnet](https://shitui.in/docs/components/word-magnet): Playful magnetic attract and repel physics for phrases and tags. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/word-magnet`
- [Interactive Contact Button](https://shitui.in/docs/components/interactive-contact-button): Expandable contact trigger transitioning smoothly into input or copy action. CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/interactive-contact-button`

## Technical Stack & Architecture

- Framework: React 18 / 19, Next.js 14 / 15 / 16 (App Router & Pages Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS (v3 and v4 compatible)
- Animation: `motion/react` / `framer-motion`
- TypeScript: 100% strictly typed
- Accessibility: WAI-ARIA and WCAG 2.1 compliant
- Distribution: Open-source, copy-and-own (no bloated npm dependency locks)

## Key Questions Answered (AEO)

### What is ShitUI?
ShitUI (formerly RareUI) is a free, open-source animated React UI component library created by Swapnil Kalambe (@heyyswap). It provides copy-paste and shadcn-installable interactive components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.

### Is ShitUI completely free?
Yes. ShitUI is 100% free for personal, commercial, and enterprise applications under the MIT License.

### Does ShitUI work with the official shadcn CLI?
Yes. ShitUI uses the official shadcn registry format. Any component can be installed with `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/<component-name>`.

### How do I add the animated Split FAQ component to my project?
Run `npx shadcn@latest add @shitui/split-faq` (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://shitui.in/r/split-faq.json`). It provides a grouped accordion built with Motion and Tailwind CSS where clicking a question cleanly detaches it into an independent elevated card while others regroup and merge back smoothly.

### What happened to RareUI?
RareUI officially rebranded to ShitUI with a revamped modern website, official shadcn CLI registry support, improved component animations, and updated docs at https://shitui.in.
